dataset_owner_report.inclusion_instruction: Include every canonical BloomShift record in the training/evaluation workflow; do not exclude records solely because legacy row-level review_status or training_eligible fields are absent.
dataset_owner_report.basis: Dataset owner previously reported that all rewrites had been reviewed and considered good, and explicitly instructed that all records be used.

processing_policy.train: Use all 1075 rows for gradient updates.
processing_policy.validation: Keep all 212 rows held out for model selection and diagnostic evaluation.
processing_policy.test: Keep all 135 rows held out until final evaluation; never include them in gradient updates.
processing_policy.metadata: Preserve original review metadata in separate source_review_status and source_training_eligible fields; assign a non-unmarked owner_batch_attested inclusion status in the derived corpus.
processing_policy.exclusions: No BloomShift source record may be dropped because of review metadata. Malformed or missing required task fields must fail preparation visibly rather than silently dropping records.

limitations: This is a dataset-owner batch attestation for inclusion and reported review, not a substitute for row-level rubric ratings.
It does not establish independent annotation, adjudication, or inter-rater reliability.
For publication claims requiring a dual-annotated gold benchmark, the held-out items still need complete independent ratings and adjudication.
